title: members.yaml, the people of a brain
description: Who belongs to a brain and with which public keys (wi-brain-identity): the people (Person), their accounts elsewhere (Account), the organizations and tenants they belong to (Organization), the groups of people (Group, nested) and their grants: a grade and roles on a node of the scope tree, or roles in an organization or tenant (Membership; brain.access, spec-brain-access). Public keys only: a private key never enters this file, the engine only verifies signatures with these keys (brain.identity). The file sits at the brain's root, next to config.json; its data class is confidential (names, accounts). Without it nothing about identity is checked.

class.description: The file's data class, said in the file too (declare it in config.json classes.stores as well).

person_id.description: A stable id: never reused, never renamed (signatures name it as their principal).

signing.description: Public SSH ed25519 signing keys, one per machine or hardware key: what verifies the person's signed answers (ssh-keygen -Y verify, namespace brain-decision).

key.description: The public half, as the .pub file holds it: type, base64, optional comment.

machine.description: Where its private half lives (a label, never a path).

since.description: The day the key was declared: answers recorded before the earliest since of the deciders' keys need no signature.

revoked.description: The day the key was revoked (a record of when): from then on it verifies nothing, a signature it made before included, since the date written in an answer is not proof of when it was signed; the owner signs those answers again with another key.

encryption.description: Public age recipients (brain vault seals to them).

accounts.description: A person's accounts elsewhere (a code host, an identity provider), linked by both sides' proof, never by an e-mail address alone.

subject.description: The login or the OIDC sub.

kind.description: A tenant is another brain's identity and key domain (HMaaS); default organization.

groups.description: Groups of people a grant names at once (brain.access): members are person_ids or other groups' ids, nested, never in a cycle. Since 0.6.0.

id.description: A stable id, never a person_id.

memberships.description: A grant: a person (person_id) or a group (group), exactly one, with a grade and roles on a node of the scope tree (scope, its synonym project; absent: Global, the whole brain), inherited down the tree by union, the highest grade winning; or roles in an organization or tenant (another identity domain, no grade). Grades: viewer < contributor < maintainer < owner (read, propose, write, administer); roles: decider (decide: its signature verifies an owner-decides answer), releaser (signs release tags), auditor; a role named as a grade reads as that grade, member as viewer. brain.access reads them (brain access explain), read only: nothing is refused by them yet. group, scope, grade, since and until since 0.6.0.

group.description: A group's id (groups): the grant holds for each of its members, nested ones included.

scope.description: A node of the scope tree by its id (frozen): a container of scopes.yaml or a project of the registry; global or absent: the whole brain.

project.description: scope's synonym (the key before the scope tree).

grade.description: viewer, contributor, maintainer or owner; another value (a newer brain's grade) reads as none, never above.

since.description: The first day the grant counts.

until.description: The last day the grant counts: after it, it grants nothing.
